title: cortusa brotheri
intro: Cortusa brotheri, commonly known as the Chinese toothwort, is a plant species that belongs to the family Primulaceae. It is widely used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Cortusa brotheri include inhibiting platelet aggregation, lowering blood pressure, and reducing oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Cortusa brotheri include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
